trigger.description: Anchored rows matched the requested recall surface (paths/symbols/diff) but the conjunctive --kind/--level/--stale filters removed them all. Distinct from anchor_index_empty so hook authors can tell 'nothing anchored' apart from 'anchored but filtered out' (ADR 0064 §5); an empty post-filter result is a normal empty recall.
setup_commands: ee remember "Anchored rule about src/db/mod.rs" --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule --json
